worldcombat.skill.spite.summary: Send a slow, homing grudge at a target: on hitting a Pokemon it tears 4 PP out of the move that target used last and leaves a grudge that slows its movement and lengthens its cooldowns. The grudge itself deals no damage and fizzles if it cannot keep up, is shaken off or meets an obstacle.
worldcombat.skill.spite.use.0: Punish a target that just acted
worldcombat.skill.spite.use.1: Tear PP out of a move a foe relies on
worldcombat.skill.spite.description.0: The grudge reaches %1$s blocks and flies at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s-block hit radius; it deals no damage itself - a hit only bites PP and leaves a grudge.
worldcombat.skill.spite.description.1: On hitting a Pokemon it cuts %1$s PP from the move that target used last; only casts within the last %2$s count, and an older move, no usable move or an empty one simply loses nothing - the grudge still clings.
worldcombat.skill.spite.description.2: Each tick the bolt turns at most %2$s degrees toward the target; if it cannot keep up, is shaken off or meets an obstacle it fizzles, biting no PP and leaving no grudge. On a hit the grudge lasts %1$s, lowering the target's movement speed by 15%% and its ability haste by 30 (skill cooldowns about 40%% longer), and a fresh hit refreshes the duration.
worldcombat.skill.spite.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.spite.growth.0: From level %1$s the memory window rises to %2$s s and the grudge lasts %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.spite.growth.1: From level %1$s the memory window is %2$s s and the range %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.spite.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of casting. Larger values chase harder and are shaken off more often on the way.
worldcombat.skill.spite.preference.ai.le: When on, the user may leave its post to send a grudge; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
